summary.text: Eduardo Castillo is a Monmouth County retail worker running a write-in general-election campaign built around workers' rights, banking reform, and family-support policy. He ran for the New Jersey General Assembly in 2025.

paragraphs.text: Describes himself as a Monmouth County resident and retail worker who has held more than six retail jobs.
Ran for New Jersey General Assembly District 13 in the November 4, 2025 general election, which was won by two Republican incumbents.
